items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I went down to Manhattan Center and Kaiser Marshall was playing the drums.

ctx.x: something that could carry me for the rest of my life, because when everybody else was off some place we was off in another place, and he must have known that he was going to die, because I went down to Manhattan Center and Kaiser Marshall was playing the drums. We were back stage.
Kaiser was playing in Chick's band?
